title: Finishing Oltean's Completeness Proof in Lean 4 for Hybrid Logic $L(\forall)$
summary: We present a machine-checked completeness theorem, in Lean 4, for the hybrid logic $L(\forall)$: propositional modal logic with nominals, the satisfaction-style binder $\forall$, and the box modality. (Machine-checked completeness for basic hybrid logic, without binders, was pioneered by Asta Halkjær From in Isabelle/HOL.) We build on Alex Oltean's 2023 Lean 4 formalization, which mechanized the syntax, semantics, Hilbert-style proof system, and soundness following Blackburn's Hybrid Completeness (1998), but left completeness unfinished.
